eye: Your eyes are the part of your head which you see with.
We saw the eyes of a big wolf.
An eye is a hole at the blunt end of a needle through which thread is passed.
To look at carefully or with interest .
eyebrow: The eyebrow is the hair that grows on the bony ridge above the eye.
eyelash: An eyelash is one of the hairs that grows on the eyelid.
eyelid: The eyelid is a piece of skin that covers the eye. The eyelid can move back, allowing the eye to "open".
The doctor looked at his eyelids.
eyeball: An eyeball is the entire round part of an eye, including the hidden part.
The doctor checked my eyeball when I got my new glasses.
If you eyeball something, you estimate or judge it; you look at it.
eye-witness: An eye-witness is someone who saw the crime in question.
eyesight: Your eyesight is your ability to see.
The motorist lost his eyesight after an accident with a lorry.
eyelet: An eyelet is a small rimmed hole in a cloth for a lace or fastener to pass through.
If you eyelet something, you make eyelets in it.
eyeliner: Eyeliner is a cosmetic that is used to outline the eye.
eyeshadow: Eyeshadow is a cosmetic that is used applied to the eyelids to give a darker complexion.
eyewitness: An eyewitness is someone who saw the crime in question.
eyepiece: An eyepiece is the lens at the eye end of an optical instrument by which the image is viewed.
eyesore: An eyesore is something that is displeasing or ugly.
